name.title: Business
name.description: The business name from the input.

website_url.title: Website URL
website_url.description: The website_url from the input: the only site that was crawled.

primary_phone.title: Primary phone
primary_phone.description: The phone number with the most independent sources, in E.164 format (+14155550100). Ties go to a number in JSON-LD, then to one on the contact page. null when agreement is none_found. When agreement is conflicting it is only the best-supported guess.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: Every number found, best supported first. Each has the sources that prove it.

sources.description: Where the number was found, one entry per page and place.

source_url.description: The page the number was found on.

found_in.description: Where on the page: a tel: link, schema.org JSON-LD, text on a contact page, text in a footer, or other visible text.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.description: consistent: one number found. conflicting: more than one number found. none_found: no number found.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: high: consistent and found in 2 or more source types. medium: consistent, one source type. low: conflicting, none_found, or the site could not be read.

confidence_reason.title: Confidence reason
confidence_reason.description: A short sentence explaining the confidence.

site_reachable.title: Site reachable
site_reachable.description: true when at least one page of the website was read (or robots.txt answered but disallows crawling).

final_url.title: Final URL
final_url.description: The homepage URL after same-host redirects. null when the site was not reached.

pages_crawled.title: Pages crawled
pages_crawled.description: How many pages were read successfully.

checked_at.title: Checked at
checked_at.description: When the check finished, ISO 8601 in UTC.

overview.title: Phone check per business
overview.description: One row per business: the phone number, how sure we are, and whether the pages agree.
